title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts the Red Sox will maintain their performance to secure a 2026 playoff spot.
The Red Sox hold the second A.L. wild-card spot with a record of 64-52, following a 15-game win streak.
FanGraphs gives Boston a 96% playoff chance, with 83.4% odds for a wild-card and 12.6% for winning the A.L. East.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was a late scratch from the Red Sox lineup Saturday due to leg swelling from a Friday night hit.
Manager Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return to the lineup Sunday after further evaluation in the morning.
Abreu has a .256 average with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs this season, significant for Boston's offensive lineup.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics.
Andruw Monasterio extended his hitting streak to 10 games, contributing a two-run single for Boston.
Red Sox remain in strong playoff position, holding the American League's second wild-card spot.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf again after World Cup due to an NFL policy requirement.
The stadium's recent turf met performance standards but lacked approval from NFL laboratory testing protocols.
The replacement turf will be the same as used in 2025, before the World Cup's grass installation.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium on Saturday.
New signing Jack Harrison debuted in the 55th minute but couldn't impact New England's attack.
Houston scored through Guilherme and Agustin Resch, capitalizing on New England's defensive lapses.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony has been out since May with a wrist injury, now ramping up by hitting off a pitching machine.
Adley Rutschman made his first rehab appearance for the Worcester Red Sox, catching for five innings.
The Red Sox are on a 9-game winning streak and expect lineup boosts from Rutschman and Anthony's returns.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless' and 'Eighth Grade' are among the top Netflix picks for August 2026.
'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' debuts on Paramount+ with Aang as a grown-up world protector.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 on Apple TV captivates viewers with its genuine portrayal of characters and struggles.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an eight-foot-tall creature sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Since 1994, the BFRO has verified 126 Bigfoot sightings in New England, investigating reports of large, mysterious creatures.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett expressed skepticism, citing lack of scientific evidence supporting the existence of Bigfoot.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, passed away at 86, known for her advice columns Dear Prudence and Dear Margo.
Margo provided advice to Meredith Goldstein, emphasizing finding happiness after loss and avoiding prolonged grief.
Margo lived in Cambridge and was known for giving practical, opinionated advice while maintaining empathy.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters in Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
Boston Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games with a 15-hit performance at Fenway Park.
Raymond Burgos debuted with the Red Sox, pitching three hitless innings of relief after Tolle's strong start.
